caption: The drawing depicts a round medallion or relief with a raised border made up of a series of circular beads around its circumference. Inside the central space of the medallion, there is a depiction of a cityscape composed of various buildings. The structures include several domed and rectangular roofs, as well as a prominent central dome and several tall spires rising above lower buildings. The buildings are illustrated in shades of gray and muted brown, giving the appearance of a metallic or stone material. In the foreground, there is a textured area that may represent water or ground, and at the base of the medallion, outside the beaded border, there is a decorative motif resembling stylized foliage or scrollwork, also rendered in the same subdued colors. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, offering a clear contrast to the darker, more detailed central image.
title: Architectural Ornament (City of Boston)
